Check podcast_digest_last_run_age_seconds{cadence="weekly"} — if THAT is fresh the enqueuer ran and nobody was due; if it is also stale the sidecar is not calling it. Check podcast_digest_last_run_age_seconds{cadence="daily_recap"}: fresh = ran with nobody due; stale/absent = not being called.

title: Monthly recommendations digest has not been enqueued in 40 days

annotations.summary: The monthly recommendations digest has enqueued nothing for >40d (fires on the 1st, so 40d is one missed month plus slack). Also shipped dead in #2119.

annotations.summary: Cadence {{ $labels.cadence }} has raised within the last 3h. Per-enqueuer isolation keeps the other cadences running, so this is the ONLY signal for a single broken assembler. On prod: docker logs player-digest-scheduler-1 | grep 'enqueuer .* failed'.

title: Mac mini host↔VM forward down (colima socket unreachable 5m)

annotations.summary: The mini stopped heart-beating mini_forward_up for 5m — lima's host↔VM forward likely broke on a network transition (docker socket + loopback ports dead), or the VM/watchdog is down. Containers + tailnet TLS nodes may be fine; the host CLI, loopback ports, and host metric collectors are blind. This is NOT a service outage — recover with a graceful `colima restart`. Runbook: recipes/colima-lima-forwarding-recovery.md.

title: DGX free memory critically low (<8GB) — host wedge risk

annotations.summary: dgx-llm-1 MemFree below 8GB for 3m — this state preceded both host wedges on 2026-09-15/16. Check for concurrent GPU model loads (ollama + vLLM share the unified pool); see chipi/agentic-ai-homelab#63.

title: DGX GPU allocation overcommitted (>75GB of the 130GB unified pool)

annotations.summary: dgx-llm-1 GPU processes hold more than 70GB of the shared unified pool — above the ~60GB full-legitimate-load budget (vLLM 30 pinned + ollama 24 capped + 5.5 fixed), so something is allocating beyond plan. Expect dgx-memfree-crit next if it keeps climbing.

title: Podcast ingestion has not run in 36h

annotations.summary: No successful full_incremental_pipeline job on prod-podcast for 36h — the nightly (cron 0 3 * * *) is not completing. Check the scheduler is registered (`scheduler: started with N enabled job(s)` in the api logs) and the job ledger at corpus/.viewer/jobs.jsonl. If the value is 99999999 the gauge is absent entirely: either the nightly has never succeeded, or the api is not exporting podcast_pipeline_last_success_age_seconds (check PODCAST_METRICS_ENABLED and that /metrics is being scraped).

title: prod logs dark (no lines 15m) — shipping broken, box may be fine

annotations.summary: No log lines from prod-podcast for 15m. The box can be perfectly healthy — check the SHIPPER, not the host. Most likely Alloy lost its endpoints override: run `docker inspect alloy | grep config_files` and confirm it lists .vps-observability-endpoints.override.yml. If missing, re-run deploy-vps-observability-endpoints.yml (a bare `docker compose up -d alloy` silently reverts to the raw, ACL-revoked homelab:9428).
No log lines from homelab for 15m (normally ~9k/15m). Check the local Alloy/collector on the mini before assuming a host problem.
No log lines from dgx-llm-1 for 15m (normally ~530/15m). If `DGX dark` is also firing the box is off/wedged; if NOT, the box is alive and only log shipping is broken.

title: DGX Alloy is dropping log entries (sender-side)

annotations.summary: Alloy on dgx-llm-1 dropped log entries in the last 15m — the sink is rejecting or unreachable. Check `reason` (queue_is_full / ingester_error / rate_limited) and whether the logs endpoint is still permitted by the tailnet ACL.

title: prod Alloy is dropping log entries (sender-side)

annotations.summary: Alloy on prod-podcast dropped log entries in the last 15m — the sink is rejecting or unreachable. Check `reason` (queue_is_full / ingester_error / rate_limited). Most likely cause: alloy was recreated without its endpoints override and reverted to the raw, ACL-revoked homelab:9428 — verify `docker inspect alloy` lists .vps-observability-endpoints.override.yml in config_files, and re-run deploy-vps-observability-endpoints.yml if not.

{{ $labels.name }} on prod-podcast restarted >3 times in 15m — a crashloop, not a deploy. If it is an nginx/web container, suspect its OWN api container is dead rather than nginx itself: nginx resolves proxy_pass at startup. Exited(127) with no app logs means runc failed a MOUNT — after a reboot that is /dev/shm, so run restage-prod-secrets.yml (surfaces: all). See DEPLOY_GOTCHAS.md §1b.
